ADMIN_PASSWORD.name: Admin Password
ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: REQUIRED. Password to log into the OpenTrader UI (email: onboarding@opentrader.pro). Choose a strong password — the UI controls trading and exchange keys.

PORT.name: Server Port
PORT.description: HTTP port for the OpenTrader server. Must stay 4000 — it matches the Railway domain target port configured in this template.

HOST.name: Bind Host
HOST.description: Bind address. Must stay 0.0.0.0 so Railway's proxy can reach the server.

DATABASE_URL.name: Database URL
DATABASE_URL.description: SQLite database location on the persistent /app/data volume. Change only if you know what you are doing.

CUSTOM_STRATEGIES_PATH.name: Custom Strategies Path
CUSTOM_STRATEGIES_PATH.description: Optional absolute path to a directory of custom strategy files. Place files on the /app/data volume so they persist across deploys. Leave empty to use built-in strategies only.
